page_title: VIL 0-3 RSO | Villarreal v Real Sociedad 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+4' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) replaces Gerard Moreno.
90+1' Today's match ends for Dani Parejo who will be replaced by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
90+1' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

89' Alex Baena (Villarreal) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top right corner. Alex Remiro pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
84' Wasted opportunity. Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.

83' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Villarreal was in an offside position.
82' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle after Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Villarreal have a free kick.
81' Alex Baena (Villarreal) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
80' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) sends a long ball forward to Alfonso Pedraza, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a throw-in.
78' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan will be replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) coming on for Umar Sadiq.
76' The resulting free kick from Alex Baena (Villarreal) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
76' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad). Villarreal are awarded a free kick.
76' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
74' The game is interrupted now, Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
74' Jose Luis Morales goes off the pitch and Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) comes on.
72' Total attempts – 10:16. The shots on goal statistics – 3:5.
69' Alex Baena plays a through ball to Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) inside the box, he has time and arrows at shot that just goes over the bar. That really was a good chance!

69' Alex Baena (Villarreal) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Alex Remiro makes a great save to stop his effort.
66' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

66' That's unlucky! Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
64' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) dribbles into the box, but Filip Jorgensen is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
64' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
62' The attendance for today's match is 19334.
60' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. One of the players from Villarreal times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Mario Melero Lopez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Here's the change. Igor Zubeldia leaves the pitch and Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
57' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Villarreal was in an offside position.
57' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
56' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
54' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Alex Baena (Villarreal), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

53' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
53' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
51' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
46' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) reacts quickest to a cross from Hamari Traore, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
46' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Adria Altimira is replaced by Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' 0 - 3 Goal! Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Mikel Merino, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) tries to put the rebound into the net from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a good save to deny him. Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the right-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Alex Remiro, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
45' Alex Baena (Villarreal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

41' 0 - 2 What a goal! Arsen Zakharyan plays it to Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Filip Jorgensen into the right side of the goal. 0:2.
41' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
40' The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
39' Hamari Traore floats in a cross for Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the left post.
38' 0 - 1 Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
38' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
36' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
35' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
33' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
30' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Benat Turrientes replaces him.
30' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
28' Real Sociedad are ruled offside.
27' It seemed like Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
26' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) brings his opponent down. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
25' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
24' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Mario Melero Lopez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

22' Alex Baena (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.

22' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Villarreal have a free kick.
21' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
20' The foul by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) was seen by Mario Melero Lopez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' Neat link-up play between Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) and Brais Mendez, but Filip Jorgensen reads the game well and the move breaks down.
16' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
13' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
13' Alex Baena (Villarreal) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
10' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

8' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Filip Jorgensen makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
7' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad win a free kick.

5' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Filip Jorgensen shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
4' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempts to find Arsen Zakharyan, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
2' Some neat passing and movement from Real Sociedad as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Mario Melero Lopez.
